quick.title: Quick Debloat
quick.summary: Turns off the loudest extras only: telemetry, studies, crash reports, sponsored content and AI features. Keeps your account, Sync, password manager and search engine.

recommended.title: Recommended
recommended.summary: Everything in config/: telemetry, ads, AI, suggestions and Mozilla messages off, Brave Search as default, curated extensions auto-installed, built-in password manager and Firefox Account/Sync disabled.

strict.title: Strict
strict.summary: Recommended plus every policy locked (greyed out in the UI) and local page translation blocked as well.

keep-sync.title: Keep Sync
keep-sync.summary: Recommended, but Firefox Account and Sync stay enabled so bookmarks, passwords and tabs keep syncing. Everything else is off.
